cases.name: DCDiag
cases.kql:
DCDiagData_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where tostring(Computer) =~ "{{dimensionValue}}"
| project-away Passed, Failed, Type
| mv-expand Status
| where tostring(Status) has "Failed" and tostring(Status) !has "DFSREvent"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TimeGenerated, Computer
| order by TimeGenerated desc

cases.name: Replication
cases.kql:
DCReplicationData_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where tostring(SourceDSA) =~ "{{dimensionValue}}"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SourceDSA
| where toint(NumberOfFailures) > 0
| order by TimeGenerated desc

cases.name: DC Port
cases.kql:
ConnectionResults_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where tostring(RemoteSystem) =~ "{{dimensionValue}}"
| mv-expand Status
| where tostring(Status) has "failed"
| order by TimeGenerated desc

cases.name: Heartbeat
cases.kql:
let TargetComputer = "{{dimensionValue}}";
let Sites = DCDiagData_CL
| where isnotempty(Site)
| extend ComputerKey = substring(tostring(Computer), 0, 8)
| summarize Site = any(Site) by ComputerKey;
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| extend ComputerKey = substring(tostring(Computer), 0, 8)
| where ComputerKey =~ TargetComputer
| extend Status = iff(TimeGenerated < ago(5m), "Delayed", "Current"), DelayMinutes = datetime_diff("minute", now(), TimeGenerated)
| join kind=leftouter Sites on ComputerKey
| project TimeGenerated, Computer = ComputerKey, Site, Status, DelayMinutes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
